queries.name: gate3_componentes_sin_producto_padre
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    r.ServerID,
    r.SystemType,
    r.ProductoCodigoFuente,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS Componentes
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos AS p
    WHERE p.ServerID = r.ServerID
      AND p.SystemType = r.SystemType
      AND p.CodigoFuente = r.ProductoCodigoFuente
)
GROUP BY
    r.ServerID,
    r.SystemType,
    r.ProductoCodigoFuente
ORDER BY Componentes DESC,
         r.ProductoCodigoFuente

queries.name: gate3_componentes_sin_insumo
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    r.ServerID,
    r.SystemType,
    r.ComponenteCodigoFuente,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS Componentes
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos AS i
    WHERE i.ServerID = r.ServerID
      AND i.SystemType = r.SystemType
      AND i.CodigoFuente = r.ComponenteCodigoFuente
)
GROUP BY
    r.ServerID,
    r.SystemType,
    r.ComponenteCodigoFuente
ORDER BY Componentes DESC,
         r.ComponenteCodigoFuente

queries.name: gate3_costos_cero_por_servidor
queries.sql:
SELECT
    ServerID,
    SystemType,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS TotalInsumos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Costo = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS CostoCero,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CostoPromedio = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS PromedioCero,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UltimoCosto = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS UltimoCostoCero,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Costo IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS CostoNulo
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY TotalInsumos DESC

queries.name: gate3_insumos_costos_negativos
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    ServerID,
    SystemType,
    CodigoFuente,
    Costo,
    CostoPromedio,
    UltimoCosto
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
WHERE Costo < 0
   OR CostoPromedio < 0
   OR UltimoCosto < 0
ORDER BY ServerID, CodigoFuente

queries.name: gate3_distribucion_unidades_receta
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    ServerID,
    SystemType,
    UnidadMedida,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS Componentes
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas
GROUP BY
    ServerID,
    SystemType,
    UnidadMedida
ORDER BY Componentes DESC

queries.name: gate3_identidad_servidor_compartido
queries.sql:
SELECT
    ServerID,
    SystemType,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS Productos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EmpresaID IS NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SinEmpresaID,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UnidadNegocioID IS NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SinUnidadNegocioID
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY Productos DESC
